entries.title: PolicyEngine Integration for Export Authorization
entries.claim_source: src/exporters/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md — Export Encryption and Authorization → Remaining
entries.expected: PolicyEngine::checkExportPermission(collection, requester_id) called before any cursor is opened; export aborted and audit-logged if denied
entries.observed: export_encryption.cpp implements AES-256-GCM encryption fully. No PolicyEngine include or call found in exportEntities() or related entry points.
evidence: src/exporters/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md, section '~~Export Encryption and Authorization~~ ✅ Implemented': 'Remaining: Full integration with PolicyEngine::checkExportPermission()...'
src/exporters/export_encryption.cpp — no PolicyEngine include or call present
entries.impact: Export access control at collection level not active; clients could export data without authorization check
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(exporters): integrate PolicyEngine::checkExportPermission() before cursor open in all exporters

entries.title: Hub Direct Upload Integration Not Implemented
entries.expected: HuggingFaceHubClient using libcurl for direct JSONL shard and dataset_card.md upload via Hugging Face Hub HTTP API without intermediate filesystem write
entries.observed: huggingface_exporter.cpp exports fully to local filesystem. No HuggingFaceHubClient or HTTP upload path implemented. No huggingface_hub_client.cpp in src/exporters/.
evidence: src/exporters/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md — 'Hugging Face Hub Direct Upload Integration' section (Target: v1.9.0, Issue: #1719)
src/exporters/ROADMAP.md — '[I] Hugging Face Hub direct upload integration (Issue: #1719)'
No huggingface_hub_client.cpp or hf_upload*.cpp found in src/exporters/
entries.impact: Users must manually upload datasets from exported files; no integrated Hub upload workflow
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(exporters): implement HuggingFaceHubClient for direct Hub upload

entries.title: Stale TODO Counter in pii_detector.cpp Header
entries.expected: Open Issues: TODOs: 0, Stubs: 0 (consistent with verified production code)
entries.observed: Header box shows 'TODOs: 1' but no actual // TODO: comment exists anywhere in the function bodies of pii_detector.cpp
evidence: grep confirms: only match for 'TODO' in pii_detector.cpp is line 14 itself (the header annotation)
entries.impact: Low — misleading metadata in file header box; no functional impact
entries.issue_title_suggestion: fix(exporters): correct stale TODOs:1 annotation in pii_detector.cpp header

entries.title: --incremental CLI Flag Missing
entries.expected: --incremental flag on the CLI export command in tools/ activating IncrementalExporter instead of JSONLLLMExporter
entries.observed: incremental_exporter.cpp is fully implemented. No --incremental argument found in tools/ files.
evidence: src/exporters/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md, '~~Incremental / Delta Export~~ ✅ Implemented': 'Remaining: --incremental flag on the CLI export command in tools/.'
entries.impact: Users must configure IncrementalExporter programmatically; no convenient CLI switch for incremental exports
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(tools): add --incremental flag to CLI export command

entries.title: ExportFormatRegistry Not Implemented
entries.claim_source: src/exporters/ROADMAP.md — Breaking Changes; src/exporters/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md — Parquet → Remaining
entries.expected: ExportFormatRegistry singleton for registering export writers by format type; enables additive extension without API changes
entries.observed: No ExportFormatRegistry or comparable registry class found in src/exporters/. Exporters are instantiated directly.
evidence: src/exporters/ROADMAP.md — Breaking Changes: 'Export format registry will be introduced...'
src/exporters/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md — Parquet Remaining: 'Register Parquet writer in a formal ExportFormatRegistry'
No export_format_registry.cpp or export_format_registry.h in src/exporters/
entries.impact: Low — new formats require direct code access; additive extensibility not yet available
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(exporters): implement ExportFormatRegistry for pluggable format registration
